text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tosen Jordan was utterly straightforward 
and completely direct about training and 
everything else.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide, who had taken on the role 
of her temporary personal tutor at her 
request, imparted one final secret to 
winning races before concluding her 
lessons.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: —Just hold your ground, no matter what.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The race itself begins. To some, she's a 
total long shot. To others, she's the one 
and only favorite. Such is the divided 
acclaim Gold Ship receives.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Like she cared about public opinion, 
though! Tosen Jordan still viewed her as a 
rival all the same. Time to settle who the 
ultimate dummy really was!
